account_activated.subject: Your account is active
account_activated.line: Your account is active. You can sign in and continue.

account_deactivated.subject: Your account is inactive
account_deactivated.line: Your account has been deactivated. Sign-in stays paused until an admin turns it back on.

account_registered.subject: Verify your email
account_registered.line1: Thanks for joining. Use the button below to confirm your email and finish setting up your account.
account_registered.line2: If you did not create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

account_reset.subject: Reset your password
account_reset.line1: We received a request to reset your password. Use the button below to choose a new one. The link works for 60 minutes.
account_reset.line2: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password will stay the same.

completed.message: Export completed successfully. Your file is ready for download.

failed.message: Export failed. Please try again later.

completed.message: Import completed successfully. {totalImported} users imported, {totalSkipped} users skipped.

failed.message: Import failed. Please check the file format and try again.

account_created.title: Account created
account_created.body: An admin created your account with the role {role}.
account_created.subject: Your account is ready
account_created.line1: An admin created an account for you with the role {role}. Sign in with this email address.
account_created.line2: This email does not contain a password. Use Forgot password to set your own.

account_email_change.subject: Confirm your new email
account_email_change.line1: You asked to use this address for your account. Use the button below to confirm it. The link works for 60 minutes.
account_email_change.line2: Until you confirm, you can keep signing in with your old email. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

registration.verified_body: Your email is verified and your account is ready.

security.password_warning: If you did not request this, use Forgot password and contact an admin.
security.email_old_line: Your account email was changed to {email}.
security.email_old_warning: If you did not request this, contact an admin.
security.email_new_subject: This email is now used to sign in
security.email_new_line: This email is now used to sign in to your account.

auth.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action
auth.role_self_forbidden: You cannot change your own role
auth.account_locked: Only a superadmin can change this account
auth.reset_link_sent: If the email exists, a reset link has been sent
auth.password_mismatch: Password and password confirmation must match
auth.password_confirmation_required: Password confirmation is required when password is provided
auth.password_required: Password is required when password confirmation is provided
auth.email_not_verified: Please verify your email before logging in
auth.invalid_or_expired_verify_link: This verification link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
